neighbours.label: Inside a block of several ALL-CAPS constant definitions (lines like SCREEN_WIDTH_PX = 800 or #define NAME value), the second and later parts of each multi-word name; not single-word caps names, the same names in lowercase snake_case, or ALL-CAPS constants used inside an expression
neighbours.short: inner parts of ALL-CAPS constant names in a definition block
fire:
export DATABASE_HOST_NAME=localhost
export DATABASE_PORT_NUMBER=5432
export CACHE_EXPIRY_SECONDS=600
quiet:
export HOST=localhost
export PORT=5432
export TTL=600

Fire and near-miss sentences written blind by a second author from the label only. Probes: camelCase definition blocks reached 0.16-0.27 (soft edge, left out of the label); the + pole is the lowercase snake_case counterpart.

predictions: Most ALL-CAPS definition blocks fire above 0.20; single-word, lowercase and in-expression near misses stay under 0.30, with in-expression uses the likeliest to leak.
